remoteDrift: Remote advanced to 8a4ad456c during work (4 external-agent commits touching only FoundationLayoutCanvas.jsx, foundationLayoutModel.js, foundationSceneInput.js, foundationSceneTransforms.js — zero overlap with candidate files; candidates remain valid against 2083c6dbb baselines and unaffected by the drift).
summary: Adds a pure ft/in entry layer for every linear-dimension surface in the foundation module behind the existing panel seams. New module foundationFtInEntry.js provides a total parser (parseFoundationDimension), a canonical formatter (formatFoundationDimension: inches → `12' 6"` / `12'` / `6.5"` / `0.375"`), the write-side draft boundary (foundationDimensionDraftValue — blank stays blank, parseable commits canonical inches, malformed stores verbatim for diagnostics, never 0/NaN coercion), and the shared controlled FoundationDimensionInput widget (draft-while-focused so partial ft/in never snaps; `title` carries field help; inline syntax hint via role=status; aria-invalid/aria-describedby wired to the existing field-issue seam). foundationGeometryInputs.js gains the additive FOUNDATION_DIMENSION_FIELDS map (label/help/placeholder/unit/ftIn/signed per section: foundation, pole, wall, wallCap, cabinet, wallOutline, landscape) plus fail-closed resolver foundationDimensionFieldMeta (unknown → null). Five panels switch their dimension inputs to the shared widget; WallShapeEditor parses rect drafts through the same parser (malformed disables Apply + hint); LandscapeDesigner applies the same draft/focus/hint contract to the cell-size field. Stored values remain canonical inches; no schema change; no stored defaults minted — placeholders are display text only.

parserContract.parseFoundationDimension: text|number → {ok:true, inches} | {ok:false, reason}. Never throws. Accepted: `150`, `150"`, `12'`, `12.5'`, `12' 6"`, `12'6`, `12'6"`, `12'-6"`, `12 6`, `12 6"`, `-12 6`, `12-6"`, `3/8`, `3/8"`, `6 1/2"`, `1 1/2`, `12 6 1/2`, `12' 6 1/2"`, `-4'`, `-27`. Mark variants ' ′ ’ ‘ ` ´ and " ″ ” normalized; case/spacing tolerant. Ambiguity rules: bare two-token pair = feet+inches (`12 6` → 150); pair ending in fraction = mixed inch (`1 1/2` → 1.5, `12 1/2` → 12.5, `6-1/2"` → 6.5); inside ' marks dash is a separator; leading dash = sign; inches never clamped (`12' 13"` → 157).
parserContract.rejects: blank (handled at draft boundary), `abc`, `12abc`, `1e3`, `12..5`, `5/0`, `'`, `12'-'`, `12'6"7`, extra marks, embedded signs, 4+ tokens, non-finite, non-string. Positivity stays with existing calc validation.
parserContract.foundationDimensionDraftValue: write boundary: non-string → verbatim; blank → ""; parseable → canonical inches; malformed → verbatim draft for diagnostics.
parserContract.foundationDimensionStoredText: number → ft/in display; verbatim string → echoed; null/undefined → blank.
parserContract.foundationDimensionInputIssue: stored verbatim draft → inline syntax hint string; else null.
parserContract.FoundationDimensionInput: controlled widget (createElement, .js module): draft-while-focused, commits every keystroke through the draft boundary, blur settles display to stored value, `title`=help (existing tooltip seam) + focused reveal, role=status hint, aria-label/aria-invalid/aria-describedby.
